public.title: 3Sum Closest
public.description: Return the sum of three distinct array positions closest to target. If two sums have equal absolute distance, return the smaller sum. There are 3 to 300 integers between -10000 and 10000; target has the same bounds.
hints: Sort, fix one value and move two pointers.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: For each first position, the monotone pair sum permits a two-pointer sweep. Compare both distance and tie rule. O(n squared) time.
